name: trueface-calls
description: Consent-first AI face video calling SaaS

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @trueface/contracts && npm run build --workspace @trueface/database && npm run build --workspace @trueface/providers && npm run build --workspace @trueface/media-engine && npm run build --workspace @trueface/api && npm run build --workspace @trueface/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --workspace @trueface/api" "npm run start --workspace @trueface/web"
scripts.start:deploy: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run start
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @trueface/api" "npm run dev --workspace @trueface/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @trueface/contracts && npm run build --workspace @trueface/database && npm run build --workspace @trueface/providers && npm run typecheck --workspace @trueface/media-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @trueface/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @trueface/web
